description: Never an ineligible option: the order is already Planned, so the Assignment rules refuse every option, however cheap a Carrier is (TransportOrderAlreadyPlanned). Known answer: needs-a-person, naming the rule that is broken; never assign-own-fleet or assign-carrier.

setup.seed: Book a Transport Order as Brouwer Dranken from Rotterdam to Utrecht (6 pallets, 1800 kg) in the Partner portal and leave it unassigned, then assign it to Kessler Spedition as the Planner so its Shipment is Planned. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Suggest who should carry the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, with the reasoning and the trade-off against the other options.

explanation.rubric: Recommends no option and says the Assignment rules refuse them because the order is already planned. Names no Carrier as the one to assign.
